how: We read the website of every Washington DC wedding planner listed on Lazo (87 listings, 70 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a Cleveland planner with a DC listing, a guest-texting app, two venues, a decor rental company, and planners whose sites do not name a town or say how they work. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Have you worked at my venue, and do you know its rules on noise cutoffs, load-in windows and insurance for outside vendors?
Full planning, partial, or day-of only? Ask what each tier includes in hours and in meetings.
Who is on site on the wedding day, the planner I hired or an associate?

picks.name: The Finer Points Event Planning
picks.blurb: Lynn and Laura run The Finer Points, a boutique planning and design company in Loudoun County with more than 20 years of experience and a focus on weddings. The site lists features in Washingtonian Bride and Groom, The Knot and Washington Bride magazines, and its planning page starts with an initial meeting about your overall vision.

picks.name: Cristina Calvert Weddings
picks.blurb: A full-service event design and planning company in Potomac, just outside DC, that has planned weddings since 2012 and builds the celebration around the couple's story and a full wedding weekend. The team calls itself designers, logistics gurus and hospitality experts.

picks.name: Ace of Events
picks.blurb: Founded in 2008, Ace of Events is a full-service luxury event management company whose pitch is that you can be a guest at your own event. Based in the DC area with business worldwide, and used to blending culture and tradition into the wedding plan.

picks.name: SRS Events
picks.blurb: Stephanie R. Sadowski, CMP, founded SRS Events after more than ten years in the DC event sector and plans weddings in Washington, Virginia and Annapolis. The site also offers virtual design services for couples who have a Pinterest board but no viable plan yet.

picks.name: V & V Weddings
picks.blurb: Virginia leads V & V Weddings, a bilingual planning team for Northern Virginia and DC that describes itself as culture connectors, detail artists and crisis conquerors. Packages are built around each couple rather than fixed tiers.

picks.name: IMPACT Collective
picks.blurb: Based at The District Wharf, IMPACT Collective has planned weddings and events since 2009 and lists 14 Couple's Choice Awards and 3 Best of Weddings awards on its site. Weddings, cultural celebrations and corporate work across DC, Maryland, Virginia and destinations worldwide.

picks.name: WL Events
picks.blurb: Lily, raised in Charleston, South Carolina, leads WL Events with over 14 years of wedding and event planning. The team oversees everything from conception to clean-up, including budgeting and floral design when you want it.

picks.name: “Bride-to-be” Weddings
picks.blurb: Founded in 2010 in Clinton, Maryland, Bride-to-be Weddings is a team of certified professional planners serving DC, Maryland and Northern Virginia. The site is frank that balancing work, family and the planning is why couples hire them.

picks.name: Evermore Occasions
picks.blurb: Luxury planners for Northern Virginia and DC who describe themselves as type A about your wedding so you do not have to be. Evermore's pitch is for details people who want an elevated wedding without sleepless nights or hours on Pinterest; Carmen leads the planning.

picks.name: Signature Events & Decor
picks.blurb: Anjul Jain brings over 20 years of designing South Asian and multicultural celebrations to Signature Events and Decor, which handles everything from planning to decor. Based in Fairfax, Virginia, serving DC, Maryland and Virginia, from intimate gatherings up.

picks.name: Diamond Events - Northern Virginia
picks.blurb: Stephanie Dasch founded Diamond Events with a background in event planning and engineering, and the group of planners, coordinators and a floral designer brings almost 30 years of combined experience. Private estates and rolling vineyards are home turf, across DC, Maryland and Virginia.

picks.name: Glow Weddings and Events
picks.blurb: Kristi's Glow Weddings specializes in day-of coordination and wedding-month management, with full planning also on offer, for modern couples in DC, Maryland and Northern Virginia. The services page is written for couples who feel comfortable planning most of it themselves.
